name: Build manager
author: Brett
description: Everything that still needs building in one list: pending builds not complete, build-queue steps not done (rework included) and plan features nothing else covers, one row per build (linked by planId). Each row shows its source, model, status, time left (estimate minus done steps, or 'no estimate'), steps progress, a 'needs split' badge for builds over 30 minutes without steps, and its steps with estimates and ticks. Filters, sorts and time left per model (Fable / Opus / Sonnet). A live tracker shows what's building right now (activity feed + builds marked in progress) with elapsed vs estimate, and a compact banner shows while a build from the list runs or just finished.
